name: Garmin HUD
description: Replaces standard stat cells with Garmin-style rolling graphs colored by live Biketerra zones. Values prefer btApp.riderController (focal/ego) at ~10Hz, falling back to biketerra-ride and then DOM scraping.

settings.label: Intervals.icu API Key
settings.description: Used to fetch indoor FTP and LTHR. Saved write-only in Terra.

settings.label: Speed unit
settings.description: Display unit for the speed cell and graph.

settings.label: Power numeric smoothing
settings.description: Smooths the power number readout (rolling graph stays instant 10Hz).

settings.label: Graph window (seconds)
settings.description: Time span visible on the rolling graphs.
